_comment: NCM is not localized. Every player- and GM-facing string lives inline in scripts/*.js and templates/*.hbs, which is where you edit copy. This file holds ONLY the keys Foundry itself resolves for us — the scene-control tooltips and the Contacts window title. Adding a key here does nothing unless something asks for it. Two rules: (1) never register a setting with an i18n key for name/hint — use a literal string, the way every setting now does, because a key that is missing here renders on screen as the raw key text; (2) run `node tools/audit-i18n.cjs` after touching either side — it fails if a requested key is absent, and lists any key here that nothing asks for.
